The included stylus operates without batteries or cables, whilst **tilt recognition of ±60 degrees** enables natural stroke guidance. Three side switches on the stylus plus various replacement nibs (standard, felt, rubber) expand usage possibilities. ## Flexible connectivity and operation Connection is provided via **USB-C or Bluetooth**, with the integrated battery providing up to 16 hours of operation. ExpressKeys and a radial menu accelerate workflow, whilst **left-handed compatibility** accommodates different users. The 16:9 aspect ratio matches modern screen formats. ## Compact dimensions for mobile use With a working area of 26.3 × 14.8 cm and overall dimensions of 29.1 × 20.6 cm, the tablet fits into standard laptop bags. The **low profile of just 4 mm** and weight of 0.41 kg make it a portable working tool. _Wacom_ includes a stylus stand and various replacement nibs. ## Before buying the Wacom Intuos Pro Medium (PTK670K0B) Pros - 8,192 pressure levels for precise stylus input - Battery-free stylus with tilt recognition ±60 degrees - Wireless Bluetooth connectivity with 16 hours battery life - Compact and lightweight (0.41 kg, 4 mm height) Cons - No display, requires external monitor ## FAQs (4) ### How long does the battery last when used wirelessly? When connected wirelessly via Bluetooth, the battery provides up to 16 hours of runtime. ### Which working methods is the ergonomic layout suitable for? The tablet's ergonomic layout accommodates both right-handed and left-handed users equally well. ### What connection options are offered? You can connect the device either via USB-C cable or wirelessly through Bluetooth. ### How precise is the input stylus? With 8,192 pressure levels, a resolution of 5,080 lines per inch, and ±60 degree tilt recognition, the battery-free stylus enables highly accurate input.
